verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page says each user's plan includes a 'ported phone number', so porting in an existing number is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack describes how the port works: whether Quo collects the losing carrier's account details, gathers the letter of authorization, or files the port itself. missing for 10: documentation of the port-in workflow (collecting account number/PIN from the losing carrier), letter of authorization capture, provider-filed port submission and status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration of porting.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my existing number in: the provider collects the losing carrier's account details and letter of authorization and files the port

citations.quote: One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
